title: Grateful Dead Live at Winterland Arena on 1967-03-18

ai_review.summary: Clear sound‑board recording with a touch of hiss captures a powerhouse Winterland set highlighted by The Same Thing, Morning Dew and Death Don't Have No Mercy.
ai_review.review: The show is widely praised for its energetic early‑Dead vibe – the long jam in “The Same Thing,” soaring “Morning Dew,” and an outstanding version of “Death Don't Have No Mercy” stand out.  The SBD source delivers clear vocals and guitars despite a little hiss, with no drop‑outs, though the ending of “Death Don't” is cut off.

ai_rating.rationale: All six reviews are 4–5 stars and overwhelmingly positive about both performance and sound; recording is good (clear but a bit hissy) while the musical quality is described as exceptional.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Some hiss and a ‘funky’ character, but vocals and guitars are clear and crisp; no drop‑outs or tape‑speed problems. End of “Death Don't Have No Mercy” is cut off.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Early‑Dead set with fast‑paced jams; the highlight is a long, creative jam in “The Same Thing,” followed by classic high‑energy numbers that keep the dance floor moving.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Creative bending and beautiful improvisation during “The Same Thing”; praised for inventive guitar work.
band_member_comments.Phil: Brilliant bass performance; reviewers note his amazing chops and evolution since ’65.
band_member_comments.Bob: Pigpen (Bobby) is described as ‘droolingly breathless’ and unusually professional on this night.
